parsed.rationale: All four types — `AccentHueKey`, `AccentSaturationKey`, `AccentBrightnessKey`, and `LCDActiveBrightnessKey` — are distinct `EnvironmentKey` conformances in `AccentColorEnvironment.swift` within the `PlayerHeaderView` package. Each key encodes a semantically separate color component (hue, saturation, brightness) or display state (LCD active brightness); their structural similarity (all are empty `type-alias-object` records with `shared_field_count: 1`) is an inherent consequence of the SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey` pattern, not accidental duplication. Collapsing them would destroy the per-component identity that SwiftUI's environment system requires. No restraint markers are present, but the coincidental-shape reason class applies because the structural overlap is domain-mandated.
